thread:
emily: Quick sync — I scanned the last 6 months of P95 latency spikes across hosted and dedicated. There's a recurring pattern: spikes align with scale-ups + cold KV cache misses. Starting an action tracker thread so we can lock owners and timelines. TL;DR: two levers: autoscaler thresholds + better model warmup/priming.

raj: Saw the same on oncall. Most incidents showed a 20–40s tail while nodes boot + models load. Logs: `gpu-init` spikes, then `kv-miss` counts jump.

sophie: Agree. We also have some request routing hitting a new variant causing full-cache repop. Could be traffic-shifting during rollouts.

ana: (ops) @emily can you share the list of incidents you used? want to check infra events against cloud provider notices.

emily: posted the incident list here: https://redwood.internal/incidents/summary/6mo-warmup (public to team). Also attached quick query results: `SELECT count(*) FROM latency WHERE p95>2s AND tag='scale' GROUP BY day;`

incidents-bot: Automated summary: 23 related spikes in last 6 months, median recovery 12m, top affected clusters: europe-1, us-west-2.

michael: Product note — a few customers reported degraded interactive experience. We should prioritize mitigations that avoid user-visible failures. Can we aim for mitigations that are invisible to callers? :eyes:

emily: Yes. Proposal and action items (rough):
- A1: Lower autoscaler "scaleUpDelay" and raise ready-by checks to avoid overloaded nodes coming into rotation too early. Owner: raj. Due: 2024-05-10.
- A2: Implement lightweight KV priming during node boot (pre-warm most common prefixes). Owner: sophie. Due: 2024-05-24.
- A3: Add synthetic warmup traffic in Deploy pipeline for new model variants (CI job that fires 10 requests). Owner: tim. Due: 2024-05-17.
- A4: Update runbook to include explicit rollback on repeated cold-cache spikes and add a checkbox for "prewarm=true" on rollout configs. Owner: ana. Due: 2024-05-10.

raj: I can take A1. Quick question: do we want a blanket change or cluster-by-cluster? I'd prefer staged rollout. I'll start with europe-1 and us-west-2.

emily: Staged rollout please. Add a canary of 5% traffic, monitor P95 for 30m, then continue.

ana: For A4 I'll draft the runbook change and slot time for a review with SRE this Thursday.

michael: For product, I'll prepare a short status blurb to send to affected customers if the mitigation changes routing. Keep me posted.

tim: I'll add the synthetic test to the deploy pipeline. Question: what are the canonical sample prompts we should use? any secret sauce for representative tokens?

sophie: Use the top 10 request prefixes from the last 30 days for each model family. I can export a list. Also suggest adding a low-cost short prompt to exercise KV paths.

emily: Good. Sophie, can you paste the prefix list in this thread when ready? Raj and Tim — will you coordinate on the canary plan and the test harness?

raj: Ack, I'll create a canary plan doc and post link here by EOD.

tim: Ack, will coordinate with raj and add job to pipeline by next week.

incidents-bot: Reminder: please add a label `pattern:warmup-autoscale` to each postmortem you update so we can synthesize across incidents.

emily: Action owners and status to update here as we go. Also, let's track estimated effort (S/M/L) in the action item comments so PM and Eng leadership can prioritize.

michael: Thanks — will follow up after the canary results.

sophie: Pasting prefixes CSV in threads soon. Also proposing an optimization experiment: staggered model load (start critical modules first). Might be low-effort.

emily: Nice. If anyone hits blockers, escalate in #eng-oncall. Otherwise we'll reconvene next Tuesday 14:00 for a short sync to review progress. :white_check_mark:

raj: Noted.

ana: Added runbook draft to https://redwood.internal/docs/runbooks/warmup-autoscale.md — review welcome.

emily: Closing loop: this thread will be the canonical action tracker for this pattern. If you update status, state the action id (A1/A2/etc) in your message.

sophie: A2 in progress — exporting prefixes now.

tim: A3 in progress — initial CI job created.

raj: A1 planned — canary doc posted.

emily: Great work team — this looks actionable. I'll update weekly until all A's are done.

michael: :thumbsup:

emily: (closing) Next sync: 2024-05-07 14:00 UTC.
